note: stopped by hand at 1230 s of simulated time (planned 1503 s): the GPU was shared with other workers' batches (about x0.1-0.25 at MAX), so the colony pair is compared at 1200 s (the neutral control, g1-colctl, ran 1203 s). The evals' results were not written; samples.csv holds the census (fid.*) every 30 s.
